name: zoolyum-os
description: Zoolyum OS — Agency Operating System (CRM, Projects, HRM, Finance)

scripts.dev: start /b cmd /c "npm run dev:api > %TEMP%\dev-api.log 2>&1" && start /b cmd /c "npm run dev:web > %TEMP%\dev-web.log 2>&1"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
